descFull: Claude Code plugin to see, review and iterate on your agent's work without leaving the terminal: show images, play videos, and run visual QA with Playwright recordings and before/after comparisons inside the Claude Code terminal. Works in any terminal that supports the kitty graphics protocol, fully cross-platform on macOS, Linux and Windows.
